scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.test:native: npm run test:native:file && npm run test:native:http
scripts.test:native:http: cmake -S native -B native/build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DAI_SERVER_AUDIT_TRANSPORT=HTTP -DFIBER_BUILD_TESTS=ON && cmake --build native/build --target fiber_ai_server_tests --parallel && ctest --test-dir native/build --output-on-failure -E '_NOT_BUILT$'
scripts.test:native:file: cmake -S native -B native/build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DAI_SERVER_AUDIT_TRANSPORT=FILE -DFIBER_BUILD_TESTS=ON && cmake --build native/build --target fiber_ai_server_tests --parallel && ctest --test-dir native/build --output-on-failure -E '_NOT_BUILT$'
